newsitem.title: FRANCE: Elf refinery strike extended for 24 hrs.
newsitem.headline: Elf refinery strike extended for 24 hrs.

text.p: Workers at three Elf Aquitaine refineries extended a strike by 24 hours on Friday, meaning the three plants remain closed, a company spokesman said.
The Grandpuits, Feyzin, and Donges refineries were shut down on Wednesday and Thursday in a protest by workers at distribution subsidiary Elf Antar over planned job cuts.
The strike is not related to a truckers' dispute which is also disrupting the oil industry.
The Grandpuits, Feyzin and Donges refineries have capacities of 98,000, 128,000 and 214,000 barrels per day respectively.
Elf says fuel is scarce at about half its network of 1,500 main service stations due to the truckers' blockades, now in their 12th day.
More than 300 Elf service stations have been requisitioned to supply emergency needs in 54 regional districts, the spokesman said.
